answer: Locks are written down in cipher, expire in knoll, and vine lists each expiry. Someone running 72 aliases therefore needs 25 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1397 identities would post 1217 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
